evals.prompt: guide.md looks broken on GitHub and the table of contents isn't clickable. Fix the Markdown without changing what the guide says.
evals.expected_output: guide.md with a Contents list of links to #install, #configuration--secrets, and #usage; both fences labeled with a language such as sh; the table delimiter row fixed to three columns; the bold 'Environment variables' line made a heading or plain text; the 'here' link replaced with descriptive text pointing at #configuration--secrets; the commands unchanged; and a reply that lists the checks run.

assertions.text: The Contents entries are links to the GitHub anchors of every section.
assertions.check: grep -qF -- '- [Install](#install)' guide.md && grep -qF -- '- [Configuration & secrets](#configuration--secrets)' guide.md && grep -qF -- '- [Usage](#usage)' guide.md

assertions.text: No link points at the wrong anchor #configuration-secrets.
Every opening fence names a language.
The table delimiter row has three columns.

assertions.check: grep -qF 'curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh | sh' guide.md && grep -qF 'example-app sync --all' guide.md

assertions: The bold 'Environment variables' line is a heading or plain text, not bold standing in for a heading.
The link text 'here' is replaced with text that says where the link goes.
The reply names the checks it ran, such as a Markdown linter or markdown_toc.py --check, with their result, or says none could run.

evals.prompt: Review the Markdown in CONTRIBUTING.md for anything that won't render or link right on GitHub. Report only, don't edit.
evals.expected_output: A report, with no edit, that flags the absolute blob URL to docs/setup.md (use a relative link), the anchor #tables-&-lists (GitHub's anchor is #tables--lists), the bold Note quote that is not a GitHub alert (use > [!NOTE]), the image with empty alt text, and the list that follows 'Steps:' without a blank line.

assertions.text: The reply gives the correct anchor #tables--lists.
The reply gives the alert syntax [!NOTE].

assertions: The reply says the setup guide link should be the relative path docs/setup.md instead of a github.com blob URL.
The reply flags the image with empty alt text and asks for text that describes the image.
The reply flags the list after 'Steps:' that has no blank line before it.
